items.title: HPQ Q2 Deep Dive: AI PCs Drive Growth Amid Margin Pressures and Cautious Outlook
items.summary: Personal computing and printing company HP (NYSE:HPQ) announced better-than-expected revenue in Q2 CY2026, with sales up 12.5% year on year to $15.68 billion. Its non-GAAP profit of $0.83 per share was 20% above analysts’ consensus estimates.

items.title: Why Is HP (HPQ) Signing A Global Wi Fi Patent Deal Now?
items.summary: HP (NYSE: HPQ) and Huawei have entered into a multiyear global Wi-Fi patent cross-licensing agreement, giving each company access to parts of the other's Wi-Fi patent portfolio. The deal grants HP rights to use certain Huawei Wi-Fi patents, with Huawei receiving reciprocal rights to HP Wi-Fi intellectual property.
